svg.title: skills-gate: one skill in front of all of them
svg.desc: A lit stone archway stands in front of a dark archive of skill cards sorted onto lane shelves: core, docs, media, ops, web, security, principles. One card, code-review, leaves its shelf, passes through the gate and reaches a terminal where skills-gate suggest ranked it for the prompt. A footer reads 148 skills banked, 389 tokens always loaded instead of 14,250, one gate.
svg.text: THE GATE TO EVERY AGENT SKILL
One skill in front of all of them.
$ skills-gate suggest "review this branch before the PR"
code-review 9.3 [core] Review the changes since a ...
blast-radius 7.1 [core] Find what a change could ...
148 skills banked · 389 tokens always loaded (was 14,250) · 1 gate
